demotion_margin.note: holds means the measured strict inequality legitimate_max < known_false_min only. No demotion threshold or implementation is proposed. Controls are all returned blocks except ina-p7 and karatsu-jikugumi2-p1 as specified; the name legitimate is not independent certification (shibata-p13 is a known false block in this remainder). Empty competitor maxima are 0. Lists include title rows in both variants. with_titles adds only titles actually assigned to the returned elevation series.
demotion_margin.interpretation: Without titles: known_false_min=0 (karatsu-jikugumi2-p1), legitimate_max=0.21009416775716538 (kani-p38), holds=false. With assigned titles: both targeted false blocks have maximum 1, the control maximum stays 0.21009416775716538, holds=true on this census. This alternative envelope changes the measured object to a title-spanning area; it does not validate a demotion rule, classify all false blocks, or change ADR-046. shibata-p13 still has no competitor.

shibata_p13.note: No returned list or elevation competes with this false framing block. Both overlap maxima are 0.

region_definition.units: pt, +x right, +y down; bbox={left,top,right,bottom}; areas pt^2; ratios dimensionless

text_item_bbox.rot_minus_90: [x-h,x] x [y-w,y]; advance upwards, ascent towards negative x; abs(rot+90)<0.01 matches verticalRuns

region_definition.section_list: Envelope of actual parseTableRegion tableRows[].items including title row; returned lists only, including 0-candidate lists. No xStart/xEnd Infinity. Slab/wall row selection remains exactly as implemented; no extra vertical-run items added.
region_definition.framing_block: All AxisCandidate.positionPt extents of returned block xGrid/yGrid, mapped to page coordinates by xSequence.alongKey; includes 0-placement blocks. Only selectedBlocks after filtering/sorting count.
region_definition.elevation: Envelope of underlying original TextItems in adopted chain dimension tokens and labelsAtLevels of each returned resolved candidate. No titles. with_titles additionally unions glyphs of titles assigned to the same candidate.
region_definition.degenerate: No items => bbox null; zero area => degenerate true. Degenerate competitor intersection 0; degenerate block ratio would be null. No degenerate regions observed.
region_definition.intersection: max(0,min(right)-max(left))*max(0,min(bottom)-max(top)) divided by whole block area. Every returned block paired with every returned list/series on the same page.
region_definition.titles_total: Sum of titles.length over returned ElevationCandidate objects; excludes raw unmatched title texts and list/framing titles.

procedure.input: Sort all 36 textitems/*.json fixtures; TextPage={...fixture.page,items:fixture.items}; call all three parsers with defaults once per page.
procedure.canonical_hash: Recursively sort object keys, omit undefined properties, retain array order; JSON.stringify without whitespace, UTF-8 SHA-256 of {lists,plan,elevations}. Numbers are unrounded.
procedure.instrumentation: Exact temporary replacement pairs in instrumentation. WeakMap keyed by VerticalRun/Token retains original glyph identities; copied DimensionToken inherits them. tableRows capture before headerIndexes is associated with returned parseTableRegion results. Block object WeakMap at blocks.push is read only for returned plan.blocks. Elevation identity tracks chains, attached labels and actual assigned title tokens; only resolved candidates after withoutOverlaps count.
procedure.restoration: Original bytes saved as base64 before instrumentation, restored byte-for-byte. All four before/after SHA-256 pairs match. All 36 parser output hashes match baseline with instrumentation and again after restoration.
procedure.retry_note: First observer counted raw blocks.push calls and hit 2 vs 1 against returned blocks: parser prefers titled blocks. Observer corrected to object identity lookup of returned plan.blocks; no parser logic changed.
procedure.bounds_note: List envelopes are read-row bounds, not certified physical tables. Elevation bounds are glyph envelopes, not full frames. B1 used level extents, so exact edges differ; check overlap results rather than copying provisional bbox coordinates.
procedure.margin_check_correction: An exploratory report-builder assertion assumed holds=false in both variants and failed before saving. Removed that unsupported expectation and recorded the computed with_titles holds=true. No data or parser was changed to fit the expected conclusion.

cleanliness.note: Changed means newly dirty/untracked or content SHA-256 differs from baseline. Initial harness hashes were captured, but changing harness files are excluded. Report self-hash is not embedded; all modified parser file hashes are independently rechecked above.
